summary: Important: php security, bug fix, and enhancement update
details:
PHP is an HTML-embedded scripting language commonly used with the Apache HTTP Server.

Security Fix(es):

* php: ext-pgsql: PHP: SQL injection via improper backslash escaping (CVE-2026-17543)

* php: PHP: Denial of Service via circular symbolic links in phar archives (CVE-2026-7260)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Rebase PHP to 8.3.33 for CVE-2026-17543 and CVE-2026-7260 in 10.2.z (JIRA:Rocky Linux-223946)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
